title: 4 Costs a Godly Man Pays Before Anyone Calls Him a Leader
caption:
Nobody votes you into this. The title, if it ever comes, comes after the cost, not before it. Apologizing first. Saying the hard thing to someone's face instead of about them. Showing up on the day it actually costs you. Taking blame that isn't fully yours.

That's the model Christ left. Pay the cost before you chase the title.

#faith #leadership #godlyman #christianman #discipleship
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
